engine: EVER visual-search LEVEL 3 — the calm single-unit detail, reached via a dark full-screen VEIL page-transition (close -> hold -> open), as a SINGLE-PAGE fixed-overlay MODAL (not a route). measured_teardown.move: open(unit): COVER ~400ms (power2.inOut) the dark veil rises to cover the viewport -> HOLD ~300ms (DOM/content swaps UNSEEN; the 'loader' is just this colour hold, NO spinner/percent/logo) -> UNCOVER ~450ms (expo.out) the veil leaves -> REVEAL: rail + plan fade-up (opacity 0->1 + y 12->0 + scale 0.985->1), then locator chips + seed stagger in last (~60-100ms). Optional: plan PERIMETER stroke-dashoffset draw-in ~600ms. REVERSE (close / 'back to the floor') replays the veil and hides the overlay (no router). State swaps per unit in a tiny object; ONE overlay node, never a DOM subtree per unit.

entry: VeilFlatDetailReveal.create(target, opts) -> { open(unit), close(), current, isOpen, destroy }. target = .vfd-overlay (a fixed, hidden modal node) > .vfd-veil + .vfd-page( .vfd-head(.vfd-back + .vfd-word) + .vfd-crumbs + .vfd-rail(.vfd-type/.vfd-sub/.vfd-area/.vfd-price/.vfd-reserve/...) + .vfd-canvas( .vfd-plan + .vfd-locators(.vfd-floorchip + .vfd-compass + .vfd-sitechip) + .vfd-seed ) ). open(unit) = { type, sub, areaM2, price, status, crumbs, planSVG(string|id), floorChipSVG, siteChipSVG, floorNr, siteBlock } -> swaps content + sets active locator fills + replays the veil.
law: transform + opacity (+ stroke-dashoffset for the optional plan draw) only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. ONE overlay node, data swapped per unit (never a DOM subtree per unit) — that is what makes it read as one system. The veil HIDES the content swap (a soft fade exposes layout shift + reads cheap). Two-tone is structural: the canvas is a real element with a LIGHTER bg than the rail (not centered-on-page). Locator chips reuse the SAME path coords as the floor/site geometry; active = data-attr -> solid dark fill. reduced-motion -> instant swap (no veil anim, no plan draw), still opens/closes. owns_pin false; Esc closes. Sets window.__LAB_OK__.
gate_mode: a fixed-overlay modal reached via a veil. Verify: at rest the overlay is hidden; open(unit) runs the veil (cover -> dark hold, NO spinner -> uncover) then reveals a TWO-TONE page (grey-blue rail + lighter canvas), fills the rail (type/area/price), injects the plan SVG, sets the floor + site locator active fills (this unit/building dark); a sold unit shows 'Продано' + disabled Reserve; 'back'/Esc replays the veil and hides it. NOTE: grab a frame ~400ms in for the veil/hold; the settled flat shows the two-tone + plan + locator chips + seed.
proven: lab: a launcher (3 unit buttons stand in for the floorplate '+') + the ONE overlay node with a clean inline apartment plan (rooms labelled), floor + site locator chips, a sculptural seed. REST: overlay hidden, not open. OPEN 282: visible, isOpen true; rail filled (3E / 60.1 M² / 23 330 820 ₽); plan SVG injected; floor locator active 294 + site active block 2 (filled dark from data); TWO-TONE confirmed (rail rgb(174,184,189) vs canvas rgb(215,221,226)); rail + plan revealed (opacity ~1). SOLD 291: price 'Продано', Reserve disabled. CLOSE: overlay hidden, not open. Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, full open cycle): 105 frames, 0.95% long frames -> PASS. Screenshots: settled = two-tone flat detail (air-luxury rail + clean plan + locator chips w/ active fills + seed at the seam); mid-transition = the veil/two-tone page mid-reveal. Relative: NEW territory — preloader-band-collapse is a SITE preloader (once, on load); this veil BRIDGES floor(dark)->detail(light) and replays on back; brand-overlay-crossfade is an opacity crossfade, not a covering veil.
